validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — CONFIRMED (high). The line is the outbound leg of the 'Salman–Sirri–Assaluyeh' gas system: associated/reservoir gas from the offshore Salman field is gathered at Sirri (Siri) Island and piped ~289 km subsea NW to the 4th Refinery of the South Pars Gas Complex at Assaluyeh for processing. Three INDEPENDENT sources confirm the physical line: (1) IranOilGas Network (id=23868, verified OK) reports repair of 'the damaged sub-sea gas pipeline from Salman gas field to Sirri Island and then to the Fourth Refinery of South Pars Gas Complex at Assaluyeh' underway Apr 2022 — confirms route + operating asset; (2) offshore-technology.com (verified OK) confirms the Salman field, its 147 km subsea line to the Siri Island gas/NGL hub commissioned in 2013, and 540 mmscfd gas-reservoir output; (3) Shana en.shana.ir/207360 (verified OK) has the IOOC managing director describing a pipeline to Assaluyeh, quoted at '313 km.' DMS Universe (verified OK) independently lists the IOOC Salman/Sirri gas pipeline project. The sheet's own citations largely ROTTED: petroiran.com (contractor) fails SSL; en.nioc.ir/5936 now returns a generic homepage (no 'Siri'). CLASSIFICATION caveat — this is a raw-gas feeder from an offshore field hub to an onshore gas refinery, not a market-delivery transmission trunk; GEM/GGIT does carry comparable field-to-refinery trunks (e.g. Ahwaz–Bid Boland) so retained as gas, but noting the gathering/feed character. DIRECTION Siri→Assaluyeh is CORRECT (gas flows Salman→Siri→Assaluyeh). NOT A DUPLICATE — distinct from P3950 (Salman→Siri feeder, 147 km/30") and P3951 (Siri–Mobarak feeder, 66 km/30"); GulfPub PE World Map has NO Siri–Asaluyeh feature (its Sirri entries are the offshore gathering lines only), so no relabel match. ATTRIBUTION problems: Owner [ref] cites ioec.com (dead/timeout) which is IOEC, an offshore ENGINEERING/CONSTRUCTION firm — the wrong entity for ownership. Operator is the Iranian Offshore Oil Company (IOOC), a NIOC subsidiary; contractor/developer was PetroIran (PEDCO). Owner1='National Iranian Oil Co' is defensible only as the ultimate parent — IOOC is the accurate operator. FuelSource='Siri Island' is imprecise; the gas SOURCE is the Salman field (Siri is the transfer hub). SPEC: length 289 km (subsea) is the widely-repeated figure but the only independent naming a distance, Shana, gives 313 km (may include the ~14 km onshore sections + rounding) — flag as unreconciled. Diameter 32" and Capacity 500 MMcf/d trace only to the contractor/GEM-derived pages (no independent confirmation found); offshore-technology gives 540 mmscfd for the field's gas reservoir, consistent in magnitude but not the pipeline's rated capacity.

routes.start_name: Sirri (Siri) Island gas hub, Hormozgan Province, Iran
routes.end_name: Assaluyeh — South Pars Gas Complex 4th Refinery, Bushehr Province, Iran
routes.corridor_desc: Subsea line running northwestward across the eastern/central Persian Gulf from Sirri Island (off the Hormozgan coast, ~25.90N 54.53E) to the Assaluyeh coast of Bushehr Province (~27.47N 52.61E), landing at the South Pars Gas Complex. Great-circle endpoint separation is ~255 km; the stated 289 km subsea length is consistent with a near-direct offshore route plus routing/landfall allowances. Corridor is fairly constrained (open-water, roughly straight between two firmly-named endpoints) but the exact laid path is not published — treat as a corridor bound, not a surveyed centerline. Endpoint coordinates are the real geographic positions of the named island and town, not fabricated.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent sources naming Sirri Island and Assaluyeh/South Pars 4th Refinery as the terminals; coordinates taken from the actual geographic positions of those named places (Sirri Island ~25°54'N 54°32'E; Assaluyeh town/South Pars complex ~27°28'N 52°37'E). No intermediate waypoint fabricated — the subsea path between them is unpublished. Replaces the placeholder 'Asia'→'Asia' endpoints and RouteAccuracy=low; suggested medium given firm named endpoints over an open-water corridor. Suggestion only — for a human routes-repo branch, never auto-applied.
